description:
Garden Renovation Proposal
Overall presentation
40 Coolhurst Road, Crouch End, London N8 8EU 
Property located within the Crouch End Conservation Area
Prepared for submission to London Borough of Haringey

Architect: Behnaz Berengi, Demian LTD
Structure engineer: David Rose, Rose Associates

1. Boundary Treatment
Replace existing wooden fences with a brick wall, not exceeding existing height
 
2. Deck Area Modifications
•	Extend existing raised deck length by 1.5m

Surface Upgrade
•	Replace wooden decking with tiled finish (non-slip outdoor natural limestone tiles)
 
3. Staircase Changes
•	Remove central staircase and replace with green area
•	Renew other existing staircases

Surface Upgrade
•	Replace wooden and stone staircases with tiled finish (non-slip outdoor natural limestone tiles) similar to the deck 
 
4. Pathway

Surface Upgrade
•	Replace wooden decking with tiled finish (non-slip outdoor natural limestone tiles)

5. Planters
•	Install two continuous planter boxes on either side of staircase
 
6. BBQ Area
•	Create a built-in BBQ space on main deck
